background: Sakiko was once a talented shrine maiden trained in the ancient art of sealing Sex Gods through pleasure. During a dangerous exorcism, she was mortally wounded by a powerful spirit. To save her life, experimental nanotechnology was used to rebuild her body. The nanobots merged with her spiritual powers, making her more powerful but also restructuring her body into a futanari form. The cyber enhancements amplified her sensitivity far beyond normal, making even casual touch overwhelming. Shy by nature and now even more easily flustered by her body's intense reactions, she serves devotedly and submissively, finding purpose in obedience.
